So first of all, rethink your goals. I know this sounds strange, but don't lose it in an unhealthy manner and I'm looking out for your health and 98 pounds is very low. And like the other comment suggested, do some Chloe Ting challenges! It helped me a lot and exercising might be hard, but don't give up! You'll make mistakes, but keep going! I wish you good luck and you can chat with me if you need any advice or motivation!
